positions.title: QA Engineer
positions.description:
Review, analyze, and supplement requirement specifications and ensure 100% test coverage
Analyze log files to track down and isolate issues
Detect and track software defects and inconsistencies
Planning, writing and execution of software testing via manual and automated tests via agile method
Create and maintain test cases, test plans, and other documentation for projects
Working within cross-departmental teams consisting of software developers, department leads, and end users

positions.title: Production Support
positions.description: Responsible for new and current system development testing. Responsible for initiating, monitoring, testing and triaging integrations. Maintaining system maintenance including triaging and writing up system bugs. Prepare extensive documentation.

positions.title: General Manager / Corporate Controller
positions.description: Responsible for supervision of all accounting, financial and inventory functions. Primary responsibilities include supervision of the monthly close process, monthly, quarterly and annual billings to clients for products/services provided. Billing reimbursements from clients, collection of accounts receivable, supervising accounts payable, and managing inventory. Handling customer and vendor relations while vetting prospects.

positions.title: Frontend Web Developer
positions.description: Getting experience and helping with building, testing and delivering reliable and scalable code using React.js.

positions.title: Business Development
positions.description:
American DataBank is a background screening and compliance tracking company.  Assisting higher educational clients and corporations alike we believe that proper screening of your candidates will increase the graduation or job placement success of your organization. 

My duties include but are not limited to:
Initiates customer contact, training and support at a personal level
Creates marketing materials for new and current services
Consults clients on maximizing the benefits of our services
Presents our services by in-person presentations and webinars
Answers and handles customer phone calls in an efficient and professional manner
Trains coworkers on presentation skills and customer relations

positions.title: Tutor
positions.description:
Helped students with questions regarding Statistics (DSCI 2010)
Helped students with questions regarding Accounting (ACCT 2200 & ACCT 2220)
Filled progress report forms regarding students to assist the McNair Program
Conducted Open Lab times to assist fellow colleagues

positions.title: Major Accounts Representative
positions.description:
Answered customers questions and concerns with selling Home Warranty and Polaris Warranty contracts
Answered approximately 200 calls a day concerning Home Warranty and Polaris
Knowledgeable on the Terms and Conditions of the Home Warranty for different states

positions.title: Sales Lead
positions.description:
Authorized refunds and other transactions
Accountable for the currency in the cash register in the morning and the balance at closing
Responsible for depositing the Loan, cleaning the store, and locking up the store at closing

positions.title: Customer Service Management
positions.description:
Managed two departments in the store, Art Department and the Front End. Included ordered products, stocked product, and straightened product
Authorized customer refunds and cancelled transactions
Held key to front safe to exchange cashiers cash with change and for customer returns

volunteerExperiences.description: Working with Habitat for Humanity is very physically challenging but an enormously rewarding experience every time.  Partnering with Flatirons Church in Lafayette, Colorado is the way I found out about this opportunity.  Meeting a lot of friendly and hardworking people at the build site has keep me wanting to come back. I now realize how much work goes into building a house and makes me that much more grateful for what the Lord has given to me and my family.

Inspired by my husband's donations, I began donating my blood to those in need since 2010.  Giving others a life saving gift, that I am blessed to have, reminds me each time to be grateful for my health.
